sections.text_helper: Section 25.6 "EXTI event protection" in chapter 25 (Extended interrupts and event controller (EXTI)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1133.
sections.section_content:
The EXTI is able to protect event register bits from being modified by nonsecure and
unprivileged accesses. The protection can be activated individually per input event,
viaEXTI_SECCFGRx and EXTI_PRIVCFGRx. At EXTI level, the protection consists in
preventing unauthorized write access to change settings of secure configurable events,
change masking of secure input events, and clear pending status of secure input events.
[Table 141. Register protection overview]
